title: tib spec
description: The spec of a service: the service, its group, its pack and its entities.

tib.description: The version of the spec format; 1.

service.description: The name of the service, in lower case words joined with hyphens.

group.description: The group of the service: the root of its packages and its Maven group.

pack.description: The template pack, by name, with its version after an at sign to pin it.

type.description: The Java type of the identifier.

strategy.description: How the identifier gets its value: identity or sequence for a Long, uuid for a UUID.

Field.description: A field of the entity, with the column that holds it.

name.description: The name of the field, in lower camel case.

column.description: The name of the column. Without one, the field's name in upper snake case.

type.description: The Java type of the field.

length.description: The length of a String; the pack picks one when there is none.

precision.description: The precision of a BigDecimal: its number of digits.

scale.description: The scale of a BigDecimal: its number of digits after the point.

Relation.description: A relation to another entity, held by a column of this entity's table.

target.description: The name of the target entity.

field.description: The name of the field that holds the target. Without one, the target's name in lower camel case.

column.description: The name of the column. Without one, the field's name in upper snake case with _ID.

Options.description: What is generated for the entity besides the entity itself.

mapper.description: Whether the entity gets a mapper between it and its DTOs.

pagination.description: Whether the queries of the entity are paginated.

events.description: Whether changes of the entity are published as events.

Entity.description: An entity: a table and the class mapped to it.

name.description: The name of the entity, in upper camel case.

table.description: The name of the table. Without one, the entity's name in upper snake case.

id.description: The identifier. Without one, a Long named id that the database assigns.

relations.description: The relations of the entity to others.

audit.description: Whether the entity records when and by whom it was created and changed.

options.description: What is generated for the entity.
